agent: TRIBE v2 dialogue prototype + 자연 진화 path strategic 검토
user_directive: CP2 까지 진입 안해도, TRIBE v2 만으로 대화가능 수준만 구현 해보는건 어때, 고민 검토. 이후 자연 진화 시키면.
core_finding: TRIBE v2 단독 dialogue 불가능 (forward perception encoder, generation decoder X). 그러나 frozen text encoder Llama-3.2-3B 를 generation 으로 unlock + TRIBE v2 BOLD 를 brain-anchor side channel 로 활용 시 hybrid dialogue 가능.

options.name: TRIBE v2 + Llama-3.2-3B end-to-end dialogue
options.architecture: user input -> Llama-3.2-3B generate -> response_a + TRIBE v2 forward (BOLD) -> BOLD PCA 64-d -> next prompt conditioning
options.brain_anchor_validity: low (forward group-mean BOLD, individual variance X, conditioning hand-crafted)
options.consciousness_claim_risk: low (forward encoder only, no claim of phenomenal state)
options.natural_evolution_friendly: high (minimal scaffolding, easy to swap components)
options.rationale_for_rank: user directive 의 prototype 즉시 실행 가능 + $0 + Mac CPU + 자연 진화 starting point 로 가장 적합. brain anchor 약하지만 dialogue 가능 demo 의 minimal viable form.

options.name: CLM + TRIBE v2 dual conditioning
options.architecture: CLM 530M (text gen) <-tension_link-> TRIBE v2 BOLD; CLM main generator, BOLD = side channel, tension_link mediator
options.dialogue_quality_estimate: uncertain (CLM 530M dialogue capability 미검증, hexa-native 강점 + smaller capacity 약점)
options.brain_anchor_validity: medium-high (CLM mind.tension <-> BOLD cross-modulate 가 anima-native)
options.consciousness_claim_risk: medium (CLM 의 G3 PhiStar 결과를 BOLD 로 anchor 하는 implicit claim)
options.rationale_for_rank: anima 의 native CLM 활용 + Llama 의존 회피 = identity 강함. 그러나 prototype 1d 목표 초과 (1주). Stage 2 escalation target.

options.name: TRIBE v2 reverse-encoded thought stream
options.architecture: TRIBE v2 BOLD prediction -> ROI activation label -> hand-crafted text template -> dialogue (e.g., DMN active = self-referential thought)
options.brain_anchor_validity: high in form (BOLD direct -> text), low in content (ROI->text mapping = hand-crafted)
options.rationale_for_rank: TRIBE v2 = forward only. anti-encoder 부재 -> reverse path 가 인공적. demo 효과 있어도 '진짜 brain decoding' 호도 위험. 권장 X.

options.name: cortexlab agentic loop (가장 complete)
options.architecture: user input -> Llama-3.2-3B generate response_t -> TRIBE v2 BOLD_t -> brain state -> next-token logit bias (DMN active -> 'I think...' prefix) -> response_t+1 brain-anchored
options.brain_anchor_validity: medium (logit bias = soft conditioning, hand-crafted mapping)
options.consciousness_claim_risk: medium-high (agentic loop 의 emergent claim 위험)
options.rationale_for_rank: Stage 4 long-horizon target. 즉시 prototype 으로는 overkill. Option A 검증 후 escalation.

options.name: 사용자 본인 EEG -> CLM bridge (Crick-Koch binding 의 anima 형식)
options.architecture: user EEG (16ch OpenBCI) -> alpha-PLV -> CLM mind.tension input -> CLM 출력 -> user EEG 변화 -> 다음 input loop
options.natural_evolution_friendly: high (real signal -> emergent behavior 관찰 좋음)
options.rationale_for_rank: phenomenal validity 가장 높음. 그러나 사용자 hardware 부담 + setup 1주. Stage 3 target.

top_recommendation_rationale: user directive 의 'prototype 즉시 + 자연 진화' 에 정확히 부합. $0, 1d, Mac CPU, minimal scaffolding. Stage 1 starting point. dialogue quality 부족 시 Stage 2 (Option B) 로 escalation. brain anchor 약점은 자연 진화 path 의 정직한 출발점이지 결함 아님.
evolution_sequence: Stage 1 ($0, 1d): Option A — 사용자 본인 dialogue test 30min
Stage 2 ($0-2, 1주): Option B — CLM substrate 통합
Stage 3 ($0, 1주): Option E — OpenBCI 사용자 EEG bridge
Stage 5 (long-horizon): AKIDA spike-event natural language emergence
